name: Deep Learning: Deepkin
subtitle: Neural nets you can touch
shortDescription: Watch backprop, filters, optimisers and attention work inside real-world scenes, then see the equation behind them. Twelve units, free, offline, no account.
longDescription:
Deep Learning: Deepkin teaches how neural networks work by letting you build and poke them. Every idea starts as a real scene (a fruit sorter, an assembly line, a hiker in a valley, a reading eye), you change the settings, and only then does the equation appear, with every symbol tappable so you can see what it means in the scene and what its value is right now.

TWELVE UNITS
From perceptron to MLP, loss and backpropagation, initialisation and activations, optimisers (SGD, momentum, Adam on a 2D and 3D valley), regularisation and normalisation, convolutional networks, residual networks, sequence models, attention and Transformers, training practice, adversarial limits, and a capstone where you train a small network and write an honest report.

HOW IT FEELS
Short sittings of a few minutes: one scene, one idea, one check. Questions use the numbers from what you just built. Wrong answers come back gently later. No streak pressure, and a clear "good place to stop".

CHECKED, NOT TRUSTED
Every number you see is computed by the app and checked by separate verifier code. Every unit lists its sources (textbooks, original papers and university course pages) and each source opens inside the app, in a sheet that covers 85 percent of the screen, so you can read it and come straight back to where you were. This app has not been reviewed by an outside expert, and it says so.

FOR WHOM
Students and self-learners who finished basic machine learning and want to see how deep networks are built and trained. Course pages from MIT, Stanford, Carnegie Mellon and UC Berkeley, and open books such as Deep Learning (Goodfellow, Bengio, Courville) and Dive into Deep Learning, are cited and linked, never copied.

FREE, OFFLINE, YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
No account and no chat window. Ads appear only at natural breaks, never in a lab or a question. Watch an optional video for a free credit, or choose Ad-Free Monthly: $3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial. It only removes ads. Cancel anytime in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.
